attribution: Each excluded physical interval is attributed once to its starting request/cohort and phase. B4 ramp/drain subsets retain their frozen cohort identity; no subset is labeled a retained full-B4 interval. 'known_wall_s' sums only observed start-to-next-pure-start spans. A terminal interval has no successor: duration_unobservable_count is explicit and its missing duration is not inferred as zero.
